+package anysyncx
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/commonspace/object/acl/list"
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/consensus/consensusproto"
+)
+
+type aclRecordReader interface {
+	AclGetRecords(context.Context, string, string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error)
+}
+
+// RefreshACL catches up a loaded space's signed ACL through the existing node
+// RPC. Tree-head synchronization can finish while a pending request is still
+// missing locally, so approval reads must be able to recover that gap without
+// replacing the account, invitation, or local space store.
+//
+// Applying through the original SyncAcl preserves signature, acceptor, chain,
+// storage, broadcast, and head-update checks. It never creates an ACL record.
+func (a *App) RefreshACL(ctx context.Context, spaceID string) error {
+	if a.localOnly != nil && a.localOnly.has(spaceID) {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if a.joining == nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("anysyncx: refresh ACL %q: joining client unavailable", spaceID)
+	}
+	h, err := a.GetSpace(ctx, spaceID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return refreshACLRecords(ctx, spaceID, h.Inner().Acl(), a.joining)
+}
+
+func refreshACLRecords(ctx context.Context, spaceID string, acl list.AclList, source aclRecordReader) error {
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	acl.RLock()
+	head := acl.Head().Id
+	acl.RUnlock()
+	// Never hold the ACL lock over network I/O. An inbound sync or a local
+	// permission change may advance the same list while this read is in flight.
+	records, err := source.AclGetRecords(ctx, spaceID, head)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("anysyncx: read ACL %q: %w", spaceID, err)
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if len(records) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	acl.Lock()
+	defer acl.Unlock()
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	// AddRawRecords tolerates records already applied by the concurrent sync,
+	// while preserving the original validation and storage error semantics.
+	if err := acl.AddRawRecords(records); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("anysyncx: apply ACL %q: %w", spaceID, err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package anysyncx
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/commonspace/object/accountdata"
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/commonspace/object/acl/list"
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/commonspace/object/acl/list/listtest"
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/commonspace/object/acl/recordverifier"
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/consensus/consensusproto"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+type aclReadFunc func(context.Context, string, string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error)
+
+func (f aclReadFunc) AclGetRecords(ctx context.Context, spaceID, head string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+	return f(ctx, spaceID, head)
+}
+
+type refreshFixture struct {
+	local   list.AclList
+	request *consensusproto.RawRecordWithId
+	before  string
+	member  string
+}
+
+func newRefreshFixture(t *testing.T) refreshFixture {
+	t.Helper()
+	return newRefreshFixtureForSpace(t, "refresh-space")
+}
+
+func newRefreshFixtureForSpace(t *testing.T, spaceID string) refreshFixture {
+	t.Helper()
+	ownerKeys, err := accountdata.NewRandom()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	memberKeys, err := accountdata.NewRandom()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	owner, err := list.NewInMemoryDerivedAcl(spaceID, ownerKeys)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	inv, err := owner.RecordBuilder().BuildInvite()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	invite := listtest.WrapAclRecord(inv.InviteRec)
+	require.NoError(t, owner.AddRawRecord(invite))
+	storage, err := list.NewInMemoryStorage(owner.Id(), []*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{owner.Root(), invite})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	member, err := list.BuildAclListWithIdentity(memberKeys, storage, recordverifier.NewValidateFull())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	request, err := member.RecordBuilder().BuildRequestJoin(list.RequestJoinPayload{InviteKey: inv.InviteKey, Metadata: []byte("refresh regression fixture")})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return refreshFixture{local: owner, request: listtest.WrapAclRecord(request), before: invite.Id, member: memberKeys.SignKey.GetPublic().Account()}
+}
+
+func TestRefreshACLRecoversSignedPendingRequestExactlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newRefreshFixture(t)
+	calls := 0
+	source := aclReadFunc(func(_ context.Context, spaceID, head string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+		require.Equal(t, "refresh-space", spaceID)
+		if calls == 0 {
+			require.Equal(t, f.before, head)
+		} else {
+			require.Equal(t, f.request.Id, head)
+		}
+		calls++
+		return []*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{f.request}, nil
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, refreshACLRecords(context.Background(), "refresh-space", f.local, source))
+	require.NoError(t, refreshACLRecords(context.Background(), "refresh-space", f.local, source))
+	require.Equal(t, 3, len(f.local.Records()))
+	require.Equal(t, f.request.Id, f.local.Head().Id)
+	requests, err := f.local.AclState().JoinRecords(false)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, requests, 1)
+	require.Equal(t, f.request.Id, requests[0].RecordId)
+	require.Equal(t, f.member, requests[0].RequestIdentity.Account())
+	require.True(t, f.local.AclState().Permissions(requests[0].RequestIdentity).NoPermissions(), "refreshing a request must not grant membership")
+}
+
+func TestRefreshACLDoesNotHoldLockAcrossNetworkAndToleratesConcurrentSync(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newRefreshFixture(t)
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	source := aclReadFunc(func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+		applied := make(chan error, 1)
+		go func() {
+			f.local.Lock()
+			defer f.local.Unlock()
+			applied <- f.local.AddRawRecord(f.request)
+		}()
+		select {
+		case err := <-applied:
+			return []*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{f.request}, err
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+			return nil, ctx.Err()
+		}
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, refreshACLRecords(ctx, "refresh-space", f.local, source))
+	require.Equal(t, 3, len(f.local.Records()))
+	require.Equal(t, f.request.Id, f.local.Head().Id)
+}
+
+func TestRefreshACLCancellationDoesNotApplyFetchedRecords(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newRefreshFixture(t)
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	source := aclReadFunc(func(context.Context, string, string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+		cancel()
+		return []*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{f.request}, nil
+	})
+	require.ErrorIs(t, refreshACLRecords(ctx, "refresh-space", f.local, source), context.Canceled)
+	require.Equal(t, f.before, f.local.Head().Id)
+	require.Len(t, f.local.Records(), 2)
+}
+
+func TestRefreshACLRefusesTamperedSignedRecord(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newRefreshFixture(t)
+	tampered := &consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{Id: f.request.Id, Payload: append([]byte(nil), f.request.Payload...)}
+	tampered.Payload[len(tampered.Payload)/2] ^= 1
+	source := aclReadFunc(func(context.Context, string, string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+		return []*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{tampered}, nil
+	})
+	require.Error(t, refreshACLRecords(context.Background(), "refresh-space", f.local, source))
+	require.Equal(t, f.before, f.local.Head().Id)
+	require.Len(t, f.local.Records(), 2)
+}
+
+func TestRefreshACLRefusesAnotherSpaceSignedChain(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newRefreshFixture(t)
+	foreign := newRefreshFixtureForSpace(t, "foreign-space")
+	source := aclReadFunc(func(context.Context, string, string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+		return []*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId{foreign.request}, nil
+	})
+	require.Error(t, refreshACLRecords(context.Background(), "refresh-space", f.local, source))
+	require.Equal(t, f.before, f.local.Head().Id)
+	require.Len(t, f.local.Records(), 2)
+}
+
+func TestRefreshACLTransportFailurePreservesLocalSignedState(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newRefreshFixture(t)
+	unavailable := errors.New("test network unavailable")
+	source := aclReadFunc(func(context.Context, string, string) ([]*consensusproto.RawRecordWithId, error) {
+		return nil, unavailable
+	})
+	require.ErrorIs(t, refreshACLRecords(context.Background(), "refresh-space", f.local, source), unavailable)
+	require.Equal(t, f.before, f.local.Head().Id)
+	require.Len(t, f.local.Records(), 2)
+}

diff --git a/internal/spaceimpl/members_refresh.go b/internal/spaceimpl/members_refresh.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/spaceimpl/members_refresh.go
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+package spaceimpl
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/anyproto/any-sync/app/logger"
+	"go.uber.org/zap"
+)
+
+const joinRequestRefreshInterval = time.Second
+const joinRequestRefreshTimeout = 3 * time.Second
+
+var memberRefreshLog = logger.NewNamed("spaceimpl.members.refresh")
+
+// refreshJoinRequests repairs a missed ACL update before an online approval
+// read. Offline and LAN-only reads keep using the local signed ACL. Concurrent
+// readers share the existing cache while one bounded refresh runs; they never
+// queue behind a slow network call. Failures preserve the cached view and are
+// observable in the native log; accepting a request still goes through the
+// authoritative ACL mutation path and its unchanged permission checks.
+func (m *membersAPI) refreshJoinRequests(ctx context.Context) {
+	if m.s.app.SyncStatus().Status(m.s.id).NetworkPeers == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	if !m.requestRefreshMu.TryLock() {
+		return
+	}
+	defer m.requestRefreshMu.Unlock()
+	if time.Since(m.requestRefreshAt) < joinRequestRefreshInterval {
+		return
+	}
+	if ctx.Err() != nil {
+		return
+	}
+	m.requestRefreshAt = time.Now()
+	refreshCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, joinRequestRefreshTimeout)
+	defer cancel()
+	if err := m.s.app.RefreshACL(refreshCtx, m.s.id); err != nil {
+		memberRefreshLog.Warn("could not refresh join requests; using the local signed ACL", zap.String("spaceId", m.s.id), zap.Error(err))
+	}
+}
